briefdescription.para: All sections with the "d" flag are grouped together by the linker to form the data section and the dp register is set to the start of the section by the boot code.
All sections with the "c" flag are grouped together by the linker to form the constant pool and the cp register is set to the start of the constant pool by the boot code.
Convert an architecture name into ELF's e_machine value.
Convert an ELF's e_machine value into an architecture name.
